note: City of Pierz campground in Pierz Park beside the city golf course, east of Little Falls; 11 more sites are seasonal. Sites 1-10 back onto the Skunk River behind a tree line, with a river swimming area by the footbridge. Two rentable shelters; the Soo Line Trail (open to ATVs) is close by. Books online as Pierz Golf Course and Campground. --Claude
summary: City + operator pages and the operator's map read: 38 numbered nightly sites (36 water/electric per the city), 11 seasonal, 50 A at four starred sites, shower house, dump, Campspot booking. Not waterfront kept (the river row sits behind a tree band). Stored $53 Campspot quote (2026-10-11) not re-read. Phone confirmed; note cleaned.
flags: SITES: stored 'all 38 with water and electric (15 held for seasonal)' is out of date. The city now says '36 water/electric sites' plus '11 Seasonal sites'; the map numbers nightly sites 1-38 plus S1-S11 seasonal. The stored 2026-10-11 Campspot read listed one type, 'electric and water RV site', 36 of 36 free.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept, with a lead: map sites 1-10 back onto the Skunk River, roughly 20-40 m away. On Esri imagery that stretch is a stream under 30 m wide, hidden under a continuous tree band (creekside at most, and canopy makes it a view). Sites 11-12 sit by the footbridge at the river's pond-like swimming area (~45.9763,-94.0905). The tree cover hides whether there is open ground to the water. A site photo (Campspot type images) could earn creekside/pond for 11-12; not changed.
OHV side: the operator lists 'Easy access to ATV on the Soo Line Trail'. A general city campground with a golf course; flag only.
SEASON: no dates posted ('open dawn to dusk seven nights a week'; '2026 reservations are open'). Left absent.
FEES: stored $53 (Campspot 2026-10-11) not re-quoted (the Campspot reader needs the driver browser; the read is a month old). Local, so no price gate.
PHONE 320-468-2662 confirmed. WEBSITE: suggest adding https://www.pierzgolfcourseandcampground.com/campground (the operator's own site) in place of or beside the city page; campspot link stays.
